title: Citizens may accept useful AI services without trusting how government uses AI
discussion_signal: The post distinguishes willingness to receive more tailored or cheaper services from trust that government will be transparent, fair and protective of personal information. It supports the atlas claim that service usefulness and institutional legitimacy are separate tests, with oversight and challenge paths remaining central.
linked_research_question: Can citizens value AI-enabled public services while withholding trust in the institutions that operate them?
limits: Single professional LinkedIn post summarizing reports
Reported percentages were not independently checked here
Professional audience and platform selection limit representativeness
